before-done.loadBearing: `uxcli run` exits 0 when no probe reports `fail`, 2 when at least one does, 1 when it could not run. You say done only after a run you made yourself, on the final state of the files, exited 0. A `fail` blocks the word done until it is fixed and re-measured, or until the human has seen it and decided; in that case you report the fail, you do not report done. A `finding` is not a pass: it is a would-be fail from a probe whose method is not yet validated. Name it as a finding and say what it says; never fold it into "passes" or "no issues". `unmeasurable` and `not-applicable` are not passes either.
